units.name: version-metadata
units.description: Holds the package's static identity constants: its name, homepage URL, semantic version string, numeric build id, author, license, and copyright. These are plain string/int literals with no logic, imported by other units that need to report or embed the library's version (for example in the default User-Agent header or the diagnostics report).
units.role: Single source of truth for the package version and metadata strings.

entrypoints.name: __version__
entrypoints.plain: The current release version string, e.g. "2.34.2".

entrypoints.name: __title__
entrypoints.plain: The distribution name, "requests".

entrypoints.name: __build__
entrypoints.plain: Numeric encoding of the version, e.g. 0x023402.

units.name: compat-shims
units.description: A compatibility layer that re-exports names from the Python standard library (urllib.parse, urllib.request, http.cookiejar, http.cookies, collections) and picks between optional third-party JSON and character-detection libraries, so the rest of the codebase can import one stable set of names regardless of Python version or which optional packages are installed. Nothing here implements new behavior; it only selects and renames existing library functionality.
units.role: Central place that resolves stdlib/optional-dependency differences into one consistent set of names for the rest of the package to import.

entrypoints.name: is_urllib3_1
entrypoints.plain: True if the installed urllib3 is a 1.x release, used to pick encoding behavior elsewhere.

entrypoints.name: chardet
entrypoints.plain: The chardet or charset_normalizer module, whichever is installed, or None if neither is.

entrypoints.name: json
entrypoints.plain: The simplejson module if installed, otherwise the standard library json module.

entrypoints.name: JSONDecodeError
entrypoints.plain: The JSON decoding error class matching whichever json module was selected.

entrypoints.name: cookielib
entrypoints.plain: Alias for the standard library http.cookiejar module.

entrypoints.name: Morsel
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of http.cookies.Morsel, used when converting browser-style cookies.

entrypoints.name: basestring
entrypoints.plain: The tuple (str, bytes), used for isinstance checks accepting either text or binary strings.

entrypoints.name: builtin_str
entrypoints.plain: Alias for the native str type.

entrypoints.name: str
entrypoints.plain: Re-exported str type, kept for backward-compatible imports.

entrypoints.name: bytes
entrypoints.plain: Re-exported bytes type.

entrypoints.name: integer_types
entrypoints.plain: The tuple (int,), used for isinstance checks.

entrypoints.name: urlparse
entrypoints.plain: Splits a URL string into its scheme/host/path/query/fragment components.

entrypoints.name: urlunparse
entrypoints.plain: Reassembles a URL from its component parts.

entrypoints.name: urlsplit
entrypoints.plain: Splits a URL similarly to urlparse but without separating params.

entrypoints.name: urlencode
entrypoints.plain: Encodes a mapping or sequence of pairs into a URL query string.

entrypoints.name: urljoin
entrypoints.plain: Resolves a possibly-relative URL against a base URL.

entrypoints.name: quote
entrypoints.plain: Percent-encodes a string for safe inclusion in a URL.

entrypoints.name: unquote
entrypoints.plain: Reverses percent-encoding in a URL string.

entrypoints.name: getproxies
entrypoints.plain: Reads OS/environment proxy configuration into a scheme-to-proxy-URL mapping.

entrypoints.name: getproxies_environment
entrypoints.plain: Reads only the *_proxy environment variables into a proxy mapping.

entrypoints.name: proxy_bypass
entrypoints.plain: Reports whether a host should skip the configured proxy, per OS settings.

entrypoints.name: proxy_bypass_environment
entrypoints.plain: Reports whether a host is covered by the no_proxy environment variable.

entrypoints.name: parse_http_list
entrypoints.plain: Splits a comma-separated HTTP header list, respecting quoted substrings.

entrypoints.name: Mapping
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of collections.abc.Mapping.

entrypoints.name: MutableMapping
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of collections.abc.MutableMapping, the base used by dict-like classes elsewhere.

effects.description: At import time, probes for the optional 'chardet' and 'charset_normalizer' packages via importlib and silently falls back to None if neither is installed.

Imports urllib3 (to read its version) and re-exports urllib.request's getproxies/getproxies_environment/proxy_bypass/proxy_bypass_environment, which read OS/environment HTTP(S) proxy configuration used elsewhere to route requests; this module itself opens no sockets.

units.name: internal-string-utils
units.description: A tiny set of low-level helpers used throughout the codebase: converting str/bytes values to the platform's native string type, checking whether a unicode string is pure ASCII, and precompiled regular expressions that validate HTTP header names and values contain no forbidden control characters. Deliberately kept dependency-light so almost every other unit can safely import it.
units.role: Provides native-string conversion and HTTP header syntax validation primitives.

entrypoints.name: to_native_string
entrypoints.signature: to_native_string(string: str | bytes, encoding: str = 'ascii') -> str
entrypoints.plain: Returns the given string as a native str, decoding bytes if necessary.

entrypoints.name: unicode_is_ascii
entrypoints.plain: Returns True if a string contains only ASCII characters.

entrypoints.name: HEADER_VALIDATORS
entrypoints.plain: Maps str/bytes to the pair of compiled regexes used to validate header names and values.

entrypoints.name: _HEADER_VALIDATORS_STR
entrypoints.plain: Compiled regexes that validate a text header's name and value contain no illegal characters.

entrypoints.name: _HEADER_VALIDATORS_BYTE
entrypoints.plain: Compiled regexes that validate a bytes header's name and value contain no illegal characters.

units.name: type-definitions
units.description: Defines the internal type-alias vocabulary (what a URL, request body, files payload, auth handler, or hook callback is allowed to look like) used to annotate the public API, plus two small runtime-checkable protocols and helper predicates for detecting file-like objects and fully-prepared requests. Almost all of its content only exists for static type checking; a couple of functions run at runtime.
units.role: Defines the shared type vocabulary and file-like/prepared-request runtime checks used across the library.

entrypoints.name: SupportsRead
entrypoints.plain: Structural type for any object exposing a .read() method, e.g. an open file.

entrypoints.name: has_read
entrypoints.plain: Runtime check for whether an object behaves like a readable file object.

entrypoints.name: SupportsItems
entrypoints.plain: Structural type for any object exposing an .items() method, e.g. a dict.

entrypoints.name: HookType
entrypoints.plain: The shape of a single event-hook callback function.

entrypoints.name: HooksInputType
entrypoints.plain: The shape accepted for the 'hooks' argument: one hook or a list of hooks per event name.

entrypoints.name: is_prepared
entrypoints.plain: Type-narrowing check confirming a PreparedRequest has its url and method set; always True at runtime.

units.name: data-structures
units.description: Two general-purpose dict-like container classes with no HTTP-specific knowledge: a case-insensitive dictionary (used for headers, where 'Content-Type' and 'content-type' must be treated as the same key) and a lookup dictionary that returns None instead of raising for missing keys and exposes entries as attributes (used for the numeric-to-name HTTP status code table).
units.role: Provides the case-insensitive dict and permissive lookup dict container types used elsewhere.

entrypoints.name: CaseInsensitiveDict
entrypoints.plain: A dict whose keys are matched case-insensitively while preserving the original casing on iteration; used for HTTP headers.

entrypoints.name: LookupDict
entrypoints.plain: A dict subclass that also exposes its entries as attributes and returns None (rather than raising) for missing keys.

units.name: status-codes
units.description: Builds the public `codes` object mapping every standard (and several joke/legacy) HTTP status code to its numeric value, reachable either as `codes.ok` or `codes['ok']`, with many codes having multiple accepted aliases (e.g. `codes.okay`, `codes.all_good`). This is pure reference data with a one-time initialization step run at import.
units.role: Publishes the human-readable-name-to-numeric-status-code lookup table used throughout the library and by users.

entrypoints.name: codes
entrypoints.plain: Lookup table mapping status-code names (e.g. 'not_found', 'teapot') to their integer HTTP status code.

effects.description: Defines no network I/O of its own; it is a static name-to-number table of HTTP status codes (its names and docstring are dense with the word 'HTTP', which is what a naive scan of this file will flag as network-related).

units.name: exceptions
units.description: Defines the complete exception and warning hierarchy that Requests raises: a single ambiguous base error carrying the request/response context, and specific subclasses for connection failures, timeouts, redirects, malformed URLs/headers/schemas, JSON decoding errors, unrewindable request bodies, and deprecation-style warnings. Every other unit that can fail raises one of these types instead of a bare stdlib exception.
units.role: Defines every error and warning type the library can raise, each optionally carrying the offending request/response.

entrypoints.name: RequestException
entrypoints.plain: Base class for all Requests errors; carries the associated request and/or response object.

entrypoints.name: InvalidJSONError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a JSON body could not be encoded or decoded.

entrypoints.name: JSONDecodeError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when Response.json() fails to parse the response body as JSON.

entrypoints.name: HTTPError
entrypoints.plain: Raised by Response.raise_for_status() for 4xx/5xx responses.

entrypoints.name: ConnectionError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when the underlying TCP/TLS connection fails.

entrypoints.name: ProxyError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a configured proxy connection fails.

entrypoints.name: SSLError
entrypoints.plain: Raised for TLS/certificate verification failures.

entrypoints.name: Timeout
entrypoints.plain: Base class for connect and read timeouts.

entrypoints.name: ConnectTimeout
entrypoints.plain: Raised when establishing the connection itself times out; safe to retry.

entrypoints.name: ReadTimeout
entrypoints.plain: Raised when the server accepts the connection but doesn't send data in time.

entrypoints.name: URLRequired
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a request is attempted without a URL.

entrypoints.name: TooManyRedirects
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a redirect chain exceeds the configured maximum.

entrypoints.name: MissingSchema
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a URL has no scheme (e.g. missing 'https://').

entrypoints.name: InvalidSchema
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a URL's scheme has no matching transport adapter mounted.

entrypoints.name: InvalidURL
entrypoints.plain: Raised for a URL that cannot be parsed or is otherwise malformed.

entrypoints.name: InvalidHeader
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a header name or value contains illegal characters.

entrypoints.name: InvalidProxyURL
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a configured proxy URL is malformed.

entrypoints.name: ChunkedEncodingError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when the server declares chunked transfer-encoding but sends an invalid chunk.

entrypoints.name: ContentDecodingError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when response content (e.g. gzip) fails to decode.

entrypoints.name: StreamConsumedError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when trying to iterate a response whose stream was already consumed.

entrypoints.name: RetryError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when the configured retry policy is exhausted.

entrypoints.name: UnrewindableBodyError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a streamed request body can't be rewound to resend after a redirect or auth challenge.

entrypoints.name: RequestsWarning
entrypoints.plain: Base class for all warnings this library emits.

entrypoints.name: FileModeWarning
entrypoints.plain: Warns that a file was opened in text mode but its length was computed as if binary.

entrypoints.name: RequestsDependencyWarning
entrypoints.plain: Warns that an installed dependency's version is outside the supported range.

units.name: ca-certs
units.description: A one-function module that hands back the filesystem path to the bundled root CA certificate file, sourced from the third-party certifi package. Used as the default trust store when verifying TLS server certificates.
units.role: Resolves the filesystem path of the default CA certificate bundle used to verify TLS connections.

entrypoints.name: where
entrypoints.plain: Returns the filesystem path to certifi's bundled root CA certificate file.

effects.description: Resolves and returns the on-disk path of the CA bundle file installed by the certifi package.

units.name: hooks
units.description: A minimal event-callback system supporting a single event, 'response', which lets callers attach one or more functions to be invoked with each Response before it's returned to the caller. Used by Session and HTTPDigestAuth to implement redirect/auth-retry behavior via callbacks.
units.role: Implements the response event-hook registration and dispatch mechanism.

entrypoints.name: HOOKS
entrypoints.plain: The list of supported hook event names; currently just ['response'].

entrypoints.name: default_hooks
entrypoints.plain: Builds a fresh empty hooks dictionary with one empty list per supported event.

entrypoints.name: dispatch_hook
entrypoints.plain: Calls every registered hook function for the given event, letting each one optionally replace the data passed to the next.

units.name: cookie-jar
units.description: Bridges Requests' own request/response objects with Python's standard library http.cookiejar machinery, which expects urllib2-style request/response objects. Provides a dict-like, pickleable RequestsCookieJar users interact with directly, plus free functions to extract Set-Cookie headers from a response into a jar, build a Cookie request header from a jar, merge jars together, and construct individual Cookie objects from raw values or browser-style Morsels.
units.role: Adapts requests' PreparedRequest/Response to the stdlib CookieJar interface and exposes a dict-like cookie jar to users.

entrypoints.name: MockRequest
entrypoints.plain: Wraps a PreparedRequest so http.cookiejar's policy logic can read its URL, host and headers as if it were a urllib2 Request.

entrypoints.name: MockResponse
entrypoints.plain: Wraps a raw response's headers so http.cookiejar can read them as if it were an httplib response.

entrypoints.name: extract_cookies_to_jar
entrypoints.plain: Reads Set-Cookie headers from a raw urllib3 response into the given cookie jar.

entrypoints.name: get_cookie_header
entrypoints.plain: Computes the Cookie header value a jar would send for the given request.

entrypoints.name: remove_cookie_by_name
entrypoints.plain: Deletes every cookie in the jar matching the given name (and optional domain/path).

entrypoints.name: CookieConflictError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a name/domain/path lookup matches more than one cookie.

entrypoints.name: RequestsCookieJar
entrypoints.plain: A cookie jar that behaves both like a stdlib CookieJar and like a plain dict (get/set/items/keys/values), and can be pickled.

entrypoints.name: _copy_cookie_jar
entrypoints.plain: Returns a deep copy of any CookieJar-like object, used when duplicating a PreparedRequest.

entrypoints.name: create_cookie
entrypoints.plain: Builds a single stdlib Cookie object from a name/value and optional attributes, filling in sane defaults.

entrypoints.name: morsel_to_cookie
entrypoints.plain: Converts a browser-style http.cookies.Morsel into a stdlib Cookie object.

entrypoints.name: cookiejar_from_dict
entrypoints.plain: Builds (or adds to) a RequestsCookieJar from a plain {name: value} dictionary.

entrypoints.name: merge_cookies
entrypoints.plain: Adds the cookies from a dict or another CookieJar into the given jar and returns it.

effects.description: morsel_to_cookie computes a cookie's expiry either from a 'max-age' offset using time.time(), or by parsing an 'expires' date string with time.strptime()/calendar.timegm().

units.name: auth-handlers
units.description: Implements the pluggable request-authentication callables users pass as the `auth=` argument: HTTP Basic, HTTP Proxy Basic, and HTTP Digest authentication (RFC 2617), including digest's challenge/response nonce bookkeeping and automatic retry-on-401 via a response hook. Each is a callable that mutates a PreparedRequest's headers before it is sent.
units.role: Provides the Basic, Proxy and Digest HTTP authentication callables attached to outgoing requests.

entrypoints.name: _basic_auth_str
entrypoints.plain: Builds the 'Basic <base64>' Authorization header value for a username/password pair.

entrypoints.name: AuthBase
entrypoints.plain: Base class all auth callables derive from; defines the callable contract that mutates and returns a PreparedRequest.

entrypoints.name: HTTPBasicAuth
entrypoints.plain: Attaches an HTTP Basic Authorization header built from a username and password.

entrypoints.name: HTTPProxyAuth
entrypoints.plain: Same as HTTPBasicAuth but sets Proxy-Authorization instead of Authorization.

entrypoints.name: HTTPDigestAuth
entrypoints.plain: Implements RFC 2617 Digest auth: on a 401 challenge it computes the digest response and automatically resends the request with credentials.

effects.description: HTTPDigestAuth.build_digest_header reads the current time (time.ctime) as one input to the client nonce used in the digest response.
HTTPDigestAuth.build_digest_header reads 8 bytes from os.urandom() to build an unpredictable client nonce (cnonce).

units.name: utils
units.description: A general-purpose grab bag of helper functions used throughout the library: computing a request body's length, reading credentials from a .netrc file, resolving proxy configuration from environment variables and NO_PROXY rules, parsing/quoting HTTP header syntax (list/dict headers, link headers, content-type charset), URI percent-encoding, guessing a response's text encoding or a JSON payload's byte encoding, atomic temp-file writes, and extracting a file from within a zip archive on the filesystem.
units.role: Shared utility functions for proxy resolution, netrc/env lookups, header/URI parsing, and misc I/O helpers.

entrypoints.name: super_len
entrypoints.plain: Determines the remaining byte length of a body object (string, bytes, or file-like), accounting for its current read position.

entrypoints.name: get_netrc_auth
entrypoints.plain: Looks up a login/password for the URL's host from a .netrc file.

entrypoints.name: guess_filename
entrypoints.plain: Tries to infer a filename from a file-like object's .name attribute, for multipart uploads.

entrypoints.name: extract_zipped_paths
entrypoints.plain: If a path points inside a zip archive rather than a real file, extracts that member to a temp file and returns its path.

entrypoints.name: atomic_open
entrypoints.plain: Context manager that writes to a temp file then atomically renames it over the target, avoiding partial writes.

entrypoints.name: to_key_val_list
entrypoints.plain: Normalizes a dict or iterable of pairs into a list of (key, value) tuples.

entrypoints.name: from_key_val_list
entrypoints.plain: Normalizes a mapping or iterable of pairs into an OrderedDict.

entrypoints.name: parse_list_header
entrypoints.plain: Parses an RFC 2068 comma-separated header list, honoring quoted substrings.

entrypoints.name: parse_dict_header
entrypoints.plain: Parses a comma-separated key=value header (e.g. a Digest auth challenge) into a dict.

entrypoints.name: unquote_header_value
entrypoints.plain: Strips surrounding quotes and unescapes a quoted header value.

entrypoints.name: dict_from_cookiejar
entrypoints.plain: Converts a CookieJar into a plain {name: value} dict.

entrypoints.name: get_encoding_from_headers
entrypoints.plain: Infers a text encoding from a response's Content-Type header.

entrypoints.name: stream_decode_response_unicode
entrypoints.plain: Incrementally decodes a byte-chunk iterator into text using the response's encoding, without buffering the whole body.

entrypoints.name: iter_slices
entrypoints.plain: Yields fixed-size slices of an in-memory string/bytes value, simulating streamed chunks.

entrypoints.name: requote_uri
entrypoints.plain: Normalizes a URI's percent-encoding so it's consistently and only as escaped as necessary.

entrypoints.name: should_bypass_proxies
entrypoints.plain: Decides whether a URL's host is covered by NO_PROXY rules and should skip any configured proxy.

entrypoints.name: get_environ_proxies
entrypoints.plain: Returns the OS/environment proxy configuration applicable to a URL, or an empty dict if it should be bypassed.

entrypoints.name: select_proxy
entrypoints.plain: Picks the most specific matching proxy URL for a request from a proxies mapping.

entrypoints.name: resolve_proxies
entrypoints.plain: Combines explicit proxy settings with environment-derived ones for a given request.

entrypoints.name: default_user_agent
entrypoints.plain: Builds the default User-Agent header string, e.g. 'python-requests/2.34.2'.

entrypoints.name: default_headers
entrypoints.plain: Builds the default header set (User-Agent, Accept-Encoding, Accept, Connection) a new Session starts with.

entrypoints.name: parse_header_links
entrypoints.plain: Parses an RFC 5988 Link header into a list of {url, rel, ...} dicts, powering Response.links.

entrypoints.name: guess_json_utf
entrypoints.plain: Detects the UTF encoding (8/16/32, any endianness, with or without BOM) of a raw JSON byte string.

entrypoints.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed
entrypoints.plain: Adds a scheme (e.g. 'http://') to a URL that's missing one, without disturbing an existing scheme.

entrypoints.name: get_auth_from_url
entrypoints.plain: Extracts a username/password embedded in a URL (e.g. http://user:pass@host/).

entrypoints.name: check_header_validity
entrypoints.plain: Raises InvalidHeader if a (name, value) header pair contains illegal whitespace/control characters.

entrypoints.name: urldefragauth
entrypoints.plain: Strips the fragment and any embedded userinfo/auth from a URL.

entrypoints.name: rewind_body
entrypoints.plain: Seeks a streamed request body back to its recorded starting position so it can be resent after a redirect.

entrypoints.name: DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH
entrypoints.plain: The filesystem path to the default CA bundle, computed once at import time.

entrypoints.name: DEFAULT_PORTS
entrypoints.plain: Maps 'http'/'https' to their standard default port numbers.

effects.description: get_netrc_auth reads a .netrc/_netrc credentials file from the user's home directory or a NETRC-env-var-specified path.
extract_zipped_paths reads a zip archive and writes an extracted member to a new temp file; atomic_open writes to a temp file and atomically renames it over the destination path.

should_bypass_proxies, get_environ_proxies, get_netrc_auth and set_environ read (and set_environ temporarily writes) OS environment variables such as no_proxy/NO_PROXY, NETRC, and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE/CURL_CA_BUNDLE to resolve proxy and auth configuration.

units.name: transport-adapters
units.description: Implements the pluggable transport layer that actually puts bytes on the wire: BaseAdapter defines the interface, and HTTPAdapter is the default implementation wrapping a urllib3 PoolManager (and per-proxy ProxyManagers) to open pooled HTTP/HTTPS connections, verify TLS certificates and client certs, send the prepared request, translate urllib3-level errors into Requests exceptions, and build a Response object from the raw reply.
units.role: Owns the urllib3-backed connection pooling, TLS verification, and request/response translation for a mounted URL scheme.

entrypoints.name: BaseAdapter
entrypoints.plain: Abstract interface a transport adapter must implement: send() and close().

entrypoints.name: HTTPAdapter
entrypoints.plain: The default HTTP/HTTPS transport adapter, backed by a urllib3 connection pool manager.

entrypoints.name: HTTPAdapter.send
entrypoints.signature: HTTPAdapter.send(request, stream=False, timeout=None, verify=True, cert=None, proxies=None) -> Response
entrypoints.plain: Opens/reuses a pooled connection and sends the prepared request over it, returning a Response or raising a translated error.

entrypoints.name: HTTPAdapter.build_response
entrypoints.plain: Converts a raw urllib3 response into a fully-populated Requests Response object.

entrypoints.name: HTTPAdapter.cert_verify
entrypoints.plain: Configures the connection's TLS verification mode and client certificate/key based on the verify/cert settings.

entrypoints.name: HTTPAdapter.get_connection_with_tls_context
entrypoints.plain: Selects (creating if needed) the pooled connection, direct or via proxy, for the given request and TLS settings.

entrypoints.name: HTTPAdapter.init_poolmanager
entrypoints.plain: (Re)creates the underlying urllib3 PoolManager with the given pool sizing.

entrypoints.name: HTTPAdapter.proxy_manager_for
entrypoints.plain: Returns (creating and caching if needed) the urllib3 ProxyManager for a given proxy URL.

entrypoints.name: DEFAULT_POOLSIZE
entrypoints.plain: Default number of connections cached per host pool (10).

entrypoints.name: DEFAULT_RETRIES
entrypoints.plain: Default retry count for failed connections (0, i.e. no automatic retry).

effects.description: HTTPAdapter.send opens (or reuses) TCP/TLS connections through urllib3's connection pool and performs the live HTTP request/response exchange (conn.urlopen), optionally through a proxy or SOCKS proxy.
cert_verify checks that the configured CA bundle path and client certificate/key files exist on disk before using them.

units.name: http-models
units.description: Defines the core HTTP message objects users and the rest of the library build and consume: Request (the user-facing, unprepared description of a call), PreparedRequest (the exact bytes/headers/URL that will be sent, built by encoding params/body/files/auth/cookies), and Response (the server's reply, with lazy content/text/json decoding, streaming iteration, redirect metadata, and raise_for_status()).
units.role: Defines the Request/PreparedRequest/Response data model and the encoding logic that turns user input into wire bytes.

entrypoints.name: RequestEncodingMixin
entrypoints.plain: Shared logic for encoding query parameters and multipart file uploads into request bodies.

entrypoints.name: RequestHooksMixin
entrypoints.plain: Shared logic for registering/deregistering event hooks on a Request or PreparedRequest.

entrypoints.name: Request
entrypoints.plain: The user-facing description of an HTTP call (method, url, headers, data, etc.) before it's turned into wire bytes.

entrypoints.name: PreparedRequest
entrypoints.plain: The fully-resolved request (exact URL, headers, body bytes) that gets handed to a transport adapter to send.

entrypoints.name: PreparedRequest.prepare
entrypoints.signature: PreparedRequest.prepare(method=None, url=None, headers=None, files=None, data=None, params=None, auth=None, cookies=None, hooks=None, json=None) -> None
entrypoints.plain: Runs the full pipeline (method, url, headers, cookies, body, auth, hooks) that turns a Request's inputs into a sendable PreparedRequest.

entrypoints.name: PreparedRequest.prepare_url
entrypoints.plain: Parses, IDNA-encodes the host if needed, merges query params into, and re-quotes the target URL.

entrypoints.name: PreparedRequest.prepare_body
entrypoints.plain: Builds the request body bytes and Content-Type/Content-Length headers from JSON, form data, streamed data, or multipart files.

entrypoints.name: Response
entrypoints.plain: The server's reply: status code, headers, cookies, redirect history, and lazily-decoded content/text/json.

entrypoints.name: Response.iter_content
entrypoints.plain: Streams the response body in chunks without buffering it all in memory.

entrypoints.name: Response.content
entrypoints.plain: Reads and caches the full response body as bytes.

entrypoints.name: Response.text
entrypoints.plain: Decodes the response content to text using the declared or detected encoding.

entrypoints.name: Response.json
entrypoints.plain: Parses the response body as JSON, raising JSONDecodeError on malformed input.

entrypoints.name: Response.raise_for_status
entrypoints.plain: Raises HTTPError if the status code indicates a 4xx or 5xx client/server error.

entrypoints.name: Response.close
entrypoints.plain: Releases the underlying connection back to the pool.

entrypoints.name: DEFAULT_REDIRECT_LIMIT
entrypoints.plain: The default maximum number of redirects to follow (30).

entrypoints.name: REDIRECT_STATI
entrypoints.plain: The set of HTTP status codes treated as automatically-followable redirects.

effects.description: Response.iter_content and Response.close read from and release the underlying raw urllib3 socket/connection (self.raw), streaming response bytes as consumed.

units.name: session
units.description: Implements the Session object, the stateful entry point most users interact with: merges per-request settings (headers, params, auth, cookies, hooks, proxies, verify/cert) with session-level defaults, dispatches the request through the mounted transport adapter for its URL scheme, times the request, follows redirect chains (rebuilding method/auth/proxy/cookies at each hop per RFC 7231), and persists cookies back into the session's jar.
units.role: Owns cross-request state (cookies, auth, adapters) and orchestrates preparing, sending, and following redirects for a request.

entrypoints.name: merge_setting
entrypoints.plain: Combines a per-request setting with the session-level default, merging dict-like values and letting the request value win otherwise.

entrypoints.name: merge_hooks
entrypoints.plain: Merges per-request and session-level event hooks without one empty side wiping out the other.

entrypoints.name: SessionRedirectMixin
entrypoints.plain: Implements the redirect-following state machine (rebuild method/auth/proxy/cookies each hop) shared by Session.

entrypoints.name: SessionRedirectMixin.resolve_redirects
entrypoints.signature: resolve_redirects(resp, req, stream=False, timeout=None, verify=True, cert=None, proxies=None, yield_requests=False, **adapter_kwargs) -> Generator[Response]
entrypoints.plain: Follows a chain of HTTP redirects, re-sending (or yielding) each subsequent request until a non-redirect response or the redirect limit is hit.

entrypoints.name: Session
entrypoints.plain: Holds cookies, default headers/auth/proxies, and mounted transport adapters shared across many requests.

entrypoints.name: Session.request
entrypoints.plain: Builds a Request from the given arguments and session defaults, prepares it, and sends it.

entrypoints.name: Session.get
entrypoints.plain: Sends a GET request through this session.

entrypoints.name: Session.post

units.description: The simple, one-off, function-based API (requests.get, requests.post, etc.) that most users reach for first. Each function opens a throwaway Session inside a `with` block, issues exactly one request through it, and returns the Response, so the caller never has to think about session lifecycle for a single call.

units.name: legacy-package-shim
units.description: A backward-compatibility shim with no functions of its own: at import time it walks sys.modules and registers extra aliases like `requests.packages.urllib3` and `requests.packages.chardet` pointing at the already-imported urllib3/idna/chardet(-or-charset_normalizer) modules, so old code written against `requests.packages.X` keeps working.
units.role: Aliases urllib3/idna/chardet into the requests.packages.* namespace for old code that imports vendored-style paths.

entrypoints.name: requests.packages (module import)
entrypoints.plain: Importing this module has the side effect of making urllib3/idna/chardet reachable as requests.packages.urllib3 etc.

effects.description: Mutates sys.modules to insert aliases (e.g. 'requests.packages.urllib3', 'requests.packages.chardet') pointing at the already-imported urllib3/idna/chardet modules, for backward compatibility.

units.name: diagnostics
units.description: A standalone bug-report helper (also runnable as `python -m requests.help`) that gathers version and environment information — Python implementation and version, OS platform/release, OpenSSL version, and the installed versions of urllib3/idna/chardet/charset_normalizer/cryptography/pyOpenSSL/requests itself — and prints it as JSON, so users can paste one blob of diagnostic info into a bug report.
units.role: Collects environment/dependency-version information into a JSON blob for bug reports.

entrypoints.name: info
entrypoints.plain: Assembles a dictionary describing the platform, Python implementation, OpenSSL, and installed dependency versions.

entrypoints.name: main
entrypoints.plain: Pretty-prints the info() dictionary as JSON to stdout; the entry point when run as `python -m requests.help`.

entrypoints.name: _implementation
entrypoints.plain: Reports the running Python implementation's name and version (CPython, PyPy, etc.).

effects.description: Reads system/platform information (platform.system/release, ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER, sys.pypy_version_info) and the versions of several optional installed packages (including urllib3, which triggers a network-related heuristic even though only its __version__ attribute is read), then main() prints the resulting JSON report to stdout.

units.name: package-bootstrap
units.description: The top-level `requests` package __init__: on import, it checks that the installed urllib3/chardet/charset_normalizer/cryptography versions fall within supported ranges (warning if not), patches urllib3 to use pyOpenSSL when the standard library lacks SNI support, silences urllib3's own DependencyWarnings, and re-exports the public API surface (get/post/..., Session, Request/PreparedRequest/Response, the exception hierarchy, codes, packages, utils) as `requests.*`.
units.role: The package entry point: validates dependency versions, wires up SNI/SSL fallback, and re-exports the public requests.* API surface.

entrypoints.name: check_compatibility
entrypoints.plain: Asserts the installed urllib3/chardet/charset_normalizer versions fall within the ranges this release supports.

entrypoints.name: _check_cryptography
entrypoints.plain: Warns if an old, slow version of the cryptography package is installed (only relevant on the pyOpenSSL/SNI-fallback path).

entrypoints.name: __all__
entrypoints.plain: The list of names exported as the public `requests.*` API surface.

effects.description: At import time, patches urllib3 to use pyOpenSSL's SSL implementation when the standard library ssl module lacks SNI support, silences urllib3's DependencyWarning category, registers a NullHandler on the 'requests' logger, and emits RequestsDependencyWarning/FileModeWarning via warnings.warn when installed dependency versions look unsupported.

Re-exports get/post/put/patch/delete/head/options/request as top-level requests.* names and imports urllib3/urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl directly; this module performs no HTTP calls itself, but it is the module through which every network-performing call in the library becomes reachable, and its urllib3/SNI/SSL references are what a naive scan flags as network-related.

violations_observed.note: models.py imports the underscore-prefixed _copy_cookie_jar helper directly from cookies.py rather than going through a public copy API; cookies.py's own inline comment ('cross-module usage in models.py') acknowledges this is a private symbol leaking across the unit boundary.

adapters.py imports the underscore-prefixed _basic_auth_str helper from auth.py to build Proxy-Authorization headers, reaching past auth.py's public AuthBase/HTTPBasicAuth/HTTPProxyAuth surface into its private implementation detail.

sessions.py separately imports the same private _basic_auth_str helper from auth.py (to rebuild Proxy-Authorization headers during redirect handling), duplicating the same boundary violation seen in transport-adapters.

utils.py imports the underscore-prefixed _HEADER_VALIDATORS_BYTE and _HEADER_VALIDATORS_STR regex tables from _internal_utils.py in addition to the public HEADER_VALIDATORS mapping that already exposes the same data.
